Hosted service privacy notice

We process account and sign-in information; hosted writing, project files, settings and related identifiers; connection and service records; and information you provide in support or privacy requests. Writing and files you upload may themselves contain sensitive personal information. Hosted processing is not end-to-end encrypted.

When enabled, internal operational counts use account/project status metadata to manage service capacity and costs. Admin receives two aggregate counts, not manuscript content or individual records. Available narration features process the text, recordings and related information needed for the feature you request. Enabling a feature is not a substitute for any separate consent required by applicable law.

You can contact privacy@breadmaker.studio to request access, correction, cancellation or objection, limit use or disclosure, or withdraw consent where it is the basis for processing. Targets can also be turned off in its controls; this does not erase existing records. Read the full hosted privacy notice for purposes and legal grounds, providers, device storage, retention and current deletion limits, rights and notice changes before creating an account. You must meet the hosted age requirement. Displaying this notice does not itself record consent or agreement.
